name: 92545 · Hemet, CA
findings: ZIP 92545 (Hemet) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92545 (Hemet) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92545 (Hemet) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
